acceptanceCriteria: Both harnesses clean only their validated run_root after final acceptance outputs; success and failure paths are covered by static and executable regression tests; cleanup failure is recorded without changing adopterAcceptance/releasePublished; required release/documentation checks pass.
goal: Ensure both public Release adopter acceptance harnesses safely clean their own validated run_root on success and failure, and record cleanup failures without changing acceptance truth.
intent: Prevent release adopter acceptance temporary-directory leakage while preserving immutable acceptance truth.
